description: 2N5457 N-channel JFET (our model from onsemi's sheet)

source.licence: Our own model built from the maker's data sheet (D-159, D-161): the values are Solum Builder's

package.name: TO-92 (DSG)
package.source: onsemi 2N5457/D (Rev. 6, February 2010), page 1: TO-92 Style 5, 1 drain, 2 source, 3 gate

fit.figure: Electrical characteristics (no typical DC curve on the sheet)
fit.method: Idss the sheet's typical 3 mA; Vp -3.06 V from its typical VGS of -2.5 V at 100 µA (square law); BETA = Idss/Vp²; LAMBDA = typical |Yos| 10 µS / Idss; CGD = Crss 1.5 pF, CGS = Ciss − Crss = 3 pF (typical). Its gm at VGS = 0 is 2 mS against the typical 3 mS: one square law can't meet both, and the bias point matters more in a pedal
fit.note: Real units spread over the sheet's whole range; a circuit's measured Idss and Vp replace these (D-130)
